originality.rationale: The one-vertex-deletion robustness of game chromatic number on both complete critical-graph deletion families is not implied by known original-graph game chromaticity, ordinary criticality, or completed-colouring reconfiguration. The exact earlier Grötzsch game value is explicitly credited; direct primary text and published graph-specific results were inspected. Remaining publication priority risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier table of game chromatic values on critical graph vertex deletions may exist.
Finite exhaustive source codes may share an unnoticed model-interpretation error even though recursion, terminal rules, and colour renaming were inspected and independently implemented.
Some historical publications are available only by citation rather than full original text; a newly found stronger statement could subsume the finite classification.

value.rationale: The complete 23-vertex-deletion families of two classically extremal smallest triangle-free four-chromatic examples form a natural sharp contrast: ordinary palette requirement drops at every vertex but adversarial game palette requirement never drops. This is a structurally motivated exact finite sensitivity classification, not an arbitrary test instance or an unqualified universal theorem.
